title: Mio: saved generated volume guides
by: Claude generation; Codex recovery and comparison
question: Does any saved guide have useful shape for the hand-built model?

media.caption: Target picture. Generated meshes remain hidden volume guides for hand-placed facets; none is a finished character.

options.label: meshy-single · Meshy from one picture
options.note: Raw generated guide, 1280368 faces, no rig. 30 credits; latest model, texture on, remesh off, image enhancement off, PBR off. The first four views show its paint; the next four show the same shape in clay. No hand-placed facet rebuild is finished.

options.label: meshy-multi-t3 · Meshy from four pictures
options.note: Raw generated guide, 681978 faces, no rig. 30 credits; latest model, texture on, remesh off, image enhancement off, PBR off. The first four views show its paint; the next four show the same shape in clay. No hand-placed facet rebuild is finished.

options.label: triposg-single · Local TripoSG shape
options.note: Raw shape only, 580,866 triangles, 290,435 vertices; no texture or rig. Seed 42, 50 steps, guidance 7, dense decoder; completed in 37 seconds at 5.21 GB peak VRAM. Claude left the PLY without renders. Codex packaged it unchanged as GLB and captured these live viewer views. Every vertex and face index matches the PLY after reload.
